heroHeadline: Russia Kills 15 in Massive Kyiv Missile-and-Drone Barrage, Damages Children's Hospital
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,638, Russia launched a massive combined attack on Kyiv — 44 cruise missiles, 2 Banderol missiles, 168 Shahed-type drones, plus ballistic and Zircon hypersonic missiles — killing 15 and injuring roughly 40, with a children's hospital, kindergarten, and residential buildings damaged across 28 locations in the capital. It followed a day of intense Russian strikes across Ukraine on Aug 19 that killed 17 and injured over 100, including a Banderol drone double-tap strike on Zhytomyr's police headquarters (3 killed, 53 injured), a minibus strike in Kherson (5 killed), and a market and hostel strike in Zaporizhzhia (1 killed). Ukraine answered with long-range drone strikes on a Russian oil refinery in Ufa and arsenals in Tula and Nizhny Novgorod oblasts. Russian military losses reached ~1,472,640 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government reports, UN monitoring missions, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical data draws on peer-reviewed scholarship. Casualty figures are contested; ranges reflect scholarly and official estimates.
